findings.comment:
Observed the following items to be soiled: 1.utensil drawer of debris on the center island, 2.utensil drawer of debris next to the oven.  Clean these items and maintain clean.
750-800d Food-contact surfaces of grills, griddles, and similar cooking devices and the cavities and door seals of microwave ovens shall be cleaned at least once a day.   The food-contact surfaces of all cooking equipment shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other accumulated soil.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed the shelf under the warmer to be dusty.  Clean the shelf and maintain clean.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment:
Observed the hand sink in the kitchen to be soiled.  Clean the hand sink and maintain clean.
750-1120 Lavatories, soap dispensers, hand drying devices and all related fixtures shall be clean an in good repair.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
1.Observed an accumulation of soil under the pipes under the dish machine.  Clean the floor and maintain clean. 2.Observed loose and peeling  tiles under the dish machine.  Repair the floor so it is smooth, durable and easily cleanable.
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.
750-1200 All floors must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean floors.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
Observed an accumulation of soil on the pipes under the dish machine and the light covers in the hood.  Clean the pipes and light fixtures.
750-1220 Walls, ceilings, and attached fixtures shall be kept clean. Clean the walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Lighting provided as required.  Fixtures shielded
findings.comment:
1.Observed an unshielded light in the walk in cooler.  Provide a light shield. 2.Observed insufficient light in the walk in cooler.  Provide at least 10 foot-candles of light.
750-1240 All lights in the food prep, food storage or kitchen area of a establishment must be properly shielded (i.e. either have a physical shield or be a shatter resistant bulb) so as to reduce the potential for cross contamination in case of breakage.  Provide properly shielded lights.
750-1230(a) Permanently fixed artificial light sources shall be installed to provide at least 10 foot-candles of light in walk in coolers.

findings.title: Thermometers provided and conspicuously placed
findings.comment: Observed that the small chest freezer in the cafeteria containing ice cream treats does not contain a thermometer.
findings.citation_text: 750.140(a) All refrigeration units used to hold potentially hazardous foods shall contain a  conspicuously placed thermometer that is accurate to ±3°F. Provide thermometers for all refrigeration units.

findings.title: Original container, properly labeled, consumer advisory
findings.comment:
Observed sealable sandwich bags in refrigerator that contained sliced meat that did not have a label with the time and date of prepararation on it.
750-140b Potentially hazardous food shall be labeled or tagged with date and time of preparation and rapidly cooled to an internal temperature of 41°F.
Label all PHF with the time and date of preparation if not in the original manufacturer's packaging.
